sites.title: Sites
sites.disabledTip: This site is disabled. It answers "not found" to everyone, operators included. Publish it again to restore it.

list.empty: No sites yet. A site shows chosen pages and forms to people outside the workspace.

create.title: New site
create.slugHelper: 2-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. It is part of the site address.
create.templateNote: Templates install from the Market and create a draft site in this project. Nothing is public until someone publishes it.

draftTip.text: Draft: only people with a site role who sign in on the site can see it.
draftTip.granted: You are now an editor of this site.

publish.title: Publish {title}?
publish.lead: Once published, people outside the workspace can open the site. This becomes public:
publish.visitorPages: {count, plural, =0 {No pages for visitors} one {# page for visitors} other {# pages for visitors}}
publish.binding: Form binding {key}: visitors submit {submit} fields and read {read} fields
publish.summaryFailed: The list of what becomes public could not be loaded. You can still publish.
publish.agents: Agents cannot change a published site directly; their changes wait in Drafts.

warn.no_visitor_page: The site has no page for visitors, so visitors will see nothing.
warn.no_home_page: No visitor page is at "/", so the site's front door is empty.
warn.missing_binding: The page {route} uses the binding "{key}", which does not exist on this site.
warn.no_url: This server does not serve the site, so there is no address to open.

unpublish.title: Unpublish {title}?
unpublish.body: Visitors get "not found". People with a site role can still sign in and preview.

disable.title: Disable {title}?
disable.body: The site answers "not found" to everyone, operators included. Pages, bindings and records are kept; publish again to restore it.

delete.title: Delete {title}?
delete.body: Its pages, bindings, roles, visitor sessions and operator sessions are removed. Form records stay in their forms. This cannot be undone.

settings.titleReadOnly: Owners, admins and site editors change the title.
settings.slugDraftOnly: The address name changes only while the site is a draft.
settings.slugAdminOnly: Owners and admins change the address name.
settings.copyFailed: The address could not be copied.
settings.deployLead: A site is normally deployed on its own origin, built for this one site.
settings.sameOriginNote: Trial mode: until a separate origin is set, this server serves the site on its own origin, shared by all sites. Use it to try a site, not to run one.
settings.originHelper: One exact https origin, for example https://help.example.com. Leave empty to serve the site from this server (trial).
settings.ancestorsHelper: Origins that may embed the site in a frame. One https origin per line, at most 8.
settings.adminOnly: Owners and admins change the deployment settings.

errors.slug_invalid: Use 2-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
errors.title_invalid: Enter a title of at most 200 characters.
errors.site_not_draft: The address name changes only while the site is a draft.
errors.site_published: Unpublish the site before deleting it.
errors.allowed_origin_invalid: Enter one exact https origin without a path, such as https://help.example.com.
errors.frame_ancestors_invalid: Enter at most 8 exact https origins, one per line.
errors.user_not_member: That person is not an active member of this workspace.
